description:
PR B owns delayed/asynchronous terminal timeouts and ordered intermediary/final delivery. Database finalization is not transport success. Prior partial green tests do not discharge delayed timeout acceptance. Carry earlier fixes/provenance through .29; no new prerequisite PR.

## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR B. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.32; no self-approval.

## Functional specifications
Retain ordered intermediary edits; revalidate final text, timeout/failure handling and final delivery errors against canonical outcome persistence. Tests use the Arabic truncation case and blocked/reordered edits through the real delivery boundary where feasible. Do not equate DB persistence with successful channel delivery.

## Files and ownership
lib/zaq/agent/status.ex; api.ex; Channels events/API/delivery boundaries; status and bridge integration tests

## Action reuse assessment
Extend ordered existing upserts/delivery; no parallel transport path. DB finalization is not delivery acknowledgment; cover delayed timeout completion, not only synchronous happy paths.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
docs/services/{agent,channels}.md

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.32. No commit/push authorization is implied.

comments.text: Regression first: async partial edit precedes later synchronous final PUT and can overwrite it. Status now awaits upsert completion for intermediary edits before final delivery; deterministic blocked-partial Arabic answer ordering test added. Status/Channel events suites: 30 tests pass; wider affected suites: 195 tests/8 properties pass; mix q passes. Keep open/uncommitted pending authorized landing.

2026-09-26 independent delivery audit while #799/#806 CI runs: Agent.Status.broadcast uses synchronous NodeRouter upsert; Agent.Api persists final outcome before scheduling a synchronous Channels delivery hop, and Channels.Api propagates bridge send_reply error in response instead of labeling it delivered. Existing blocked Arabic partial regression verifies edit completion order. Focused Status/Agent API/Channels API/JidoChat delivery 179 tests/1 property passed on restacked head. Need explicit integration validation for terminal delivery error and timeout path before claiming full .8 acceptance; no new code or E2E authored this pass.

2026-09-26 #799 owning branch: added Channels.Api delivery-boundary acceptance test with a real Api.handle_event(:deliver_outgoing) and external transport timeout stub: outgoing full Arabic answer exists, bridge send_reply is attempted, final Event.response is {:error, :timeout}, not false success. Existing Status blocked-partial test proves ordered edits. Focused Channels API/Status/Agent API 171 tests pass, mix q passes, git diff --check clean. Reused existing synchronous upsert and delivery event operations; test-only failure collaborator at transport boundary, no Action or production operation added. Commit/push after #806 current CI completes so upstream test-only change does not interrupt pending validation; .8 remains in progress pending follow-up on async timeout semantics if needed.
